what: While cooking for the other Eternals, Gilgamesh tells them about a secret brew recipe Odin taught him after the Eternals helped Asgard in battle.
why_it_counts: Odin taught him the recipe himself.

what: During the dinner at Gilgamesh's house, Kingo says he knew Thor as a child and that the young Thor used to follow him around.
why_it_counts: He knew Thor as a boy, and Thor followed him around.

what: After the Rum Punch Massacre, Ridley tells Misty that Bulletin reporter Karen Page just called her for a quote about a living witness.
why_it_counts: Karen calls Ridley for a quote; they speak.

what: Joy shows Ward blackmail dirt on the Rand board gathered by the private investigator she hired, Jessica Jones, who she says was worth every penny when she was sober.
why_it_counts: She hired Jessica as her investigator.

what: During Coulson's lie-detector screening of the team, it comes out that Garrett would get a call from Alexander Pierce once in a while and said they had mutual friends.
why_it_counts: Pierce calls Garrett now and then; they have mutual friends.

what: A close-up of May's phone in "Face My Enemy" shows Natasha Romanoff saved in her contacts.
why_it_counts: Natasha is in May's phone contacts.

what: A close-up of May's phone in "Face My Enemy" shows Jimmy Woo saved in her contacts.
why_it_counts: Jimmy Woo is in May's phone contacts.

what: Coulson tells Steve that Banner thought gamma radiation might hold the key to unlocking Erskine's original formula, which is what Banner was working on when he became the Hulk.
why_it_counts: Banner's attempt to recreate Erskine's formula made him the Hulk.

what: While explaining how Hydra changed history, Zola says accidents will happen as a newspaper clipping about the Starks' fatal car crash appears on his screen, hinting Hydra had Maria and Howard Stark killed.
why_it_counts: Zola's Hydra had Maria and Howard Stark killed, the secret that breaks the Avengers apart.

what: Coulson tells Sitwell the World Security Council wants Blonsky exonerated, released and added to the Avengers roster, and later reports that Blonsky will stay in his cage.
why_it_counts: Coulson works to keep Blonsky caged and off the Avengers.

what: Sitwell discusses Blonsky with Coulson, calling him the Abomination and plotting with Coulson to keep the Council from getting him released.
why_it_counts: Sitwell plots with Coulson to keep Blonsky caged.

what: At Natasha's grave, Valentina tells Yelena that Clint Barton is the man responsible for her sister's death and offers her the chance to go after him.
why_it_counts: Valentina sends Yelena to kill Clint for Natasha's death.

said_in: Shang-Chi and the Legend of the Ten Rings
what: Wenwu tells Katy that an American terrorist stole his Ten Rings legend and invented the name Mandarin for a figurehead, describing Killian's scheme without saying his name.
why_it_counts: Killian's fake Mandarin made Wenwu break Trevor out and set the Ten Rings moving.

said_in: The Falcon and the Winter Soldier
what: In episode 2, John Walker tells Good Morning America that he followed Steve Rogers' career closely, modeled his work after him and feels like he is a brother even though he never met him, as he takes over as the new Captain America.
why_it_counts: Walker takes up Steve's shield as the new Captain America.

said_in: The Falcon and the Winter Soldier
what: In episode 3, Dr. Wilfred Nagel boasts that by recreating the super soldier serum he did what no other scientist since Erskine had been able to do.
why_it_counts: Nagel recreated Erskine's serum, which made the Flag Smashers.

what: In the 1997 flashback of episode 2, young Gravik is among the Skrull refugees when Nick Fury promises that he and Carol Danvers will find them a new home, and that broken promise drives Gravik, who later takes the Harvest containing Carol Danvers' DNA.
why_it_counts: Carol's broken promise turned Gravik, and he takes her DNA in the Harvest.

what: In episode 3, Ezekiel Stane tells Riri that the plane crash story is a lie and that his dad died trying to kill Tony Stark.
why_it_counts: Ezekiel's father died trying to kill Tony, which shapes his whole life.

what: In episode 4, while going through Stark's old records, the AIs learn that Tony Stark based each of them on a real person, with J.A.R.V.I.S. modeled on Edwin Jarvis, the Stark family butler.
why_it_counts: J.A.R.V.I.S. was modeled on Edwin Jarvis, the root of who he is.

what: Young Matt sobs to Stick that his dad was paid to lose against Creel but won because Matt wanted him to, and was killed for it.
why_it_counts: Creel was the fight Jack Murdock refused to lose, which got him killed.

what: In the post-credits scene Yelena complains that Sam Wilson is suing the New Avengers over the Avengers name and asks Bucky whether he talked to him.
why_it_counts: Sam is suing Yelena's team; they may have dealt with each other.

what: At her impeachment hearing, Valentina cites former President Ross's rampage as Red Hulk as a reason more super-powered protectors are needed.
why_it_counts: Valentina cites Ross; their working history is unclear.

what: In the season 2 premiere, Attorney General Steverud resists Mayor Fisk's anti-vigilante plans until he takes a phone call from Miss de Fontaine, after which he promises Fisk his office's full support.
why_it_counts: Valentina's call wins Fisk support; whether they know each other is unclear.

what: In episode 6, Raza, the Ten Rings leader from Iron Man, arrives with an armed team to take the bounty and demands that Paladin hand over Vision alive.
why_it_counts: Raza hunts Vision for a bounty in VisionQuest; check whether they face each other.

what: In a flashback, the agents releasing Werner Reinhardt from prison say Undersecretary Pierce took pity on him, and the team later learns Pierce granted his parole.
why_it_counts: Pierce granted Whitehall's parole; they may have met.

what: Lorelei taunts Sif that she will never have Thor, a man who considers her more pet than woman.
why_it_counts: Lorelei knows Thor from Asgard, and he likely knows her.

what: Sif explains that Odin ordered her to bring the escaped prisoner Lorelei back alive to the Asgardian dungeons.
why_it_counts: Odin had Lorelei imprisoned; he knows his prisoner.

what: Bobbi identifies the UN attacker as Marcus Scarlotti, the assassin who almost killed Barton a few years back.
why_it_counts: Bobbi speaks of Barton as someone she knows; they may be colleagues.

what: Gilgamesh recalls that the brew recipe came from Odin after the Eternals helped defeat Laufey's army.
why_it_counts: Gilgamesh fought Laufey's army, not Laufey.
